facts.fact: The ICT minister told Parliament on 6 December 2023 that the National Backbone Infrastructure covered about 50 per cent of the country and that roughly 62 districts were not covered by phases I to IV, which Phase V with last-mile connections is to reach; this is network coverage, not offices stated as connected.
facts.system: National Data Transmission Backbone Infrastructure/e-Government Infrastructure Project (NBI/EGI)

facts.fact: Parliament on 6 December 2023 authorised borrowing of up to RMB 1,050,000,000 from the Export-Import Bank of China, on 20-year, 2 per cent terms, to finance Phase V of the backbone and e-Government infrastructure project, the proceeds covering about 100 per cent of the commercial contract.
facts.system: National Data Transmission Backbone Infrastructure/e-Government Infrastructure Project Phase V

facts.fact: The Committee on National Economy reported that the state agency NITA-U, as end user, contracted the China International Telecommunication Construction Corporation on 22 April 2022 to supply, install and commission Phase V, and Parliament told NITA-U to fast-track extension to the last-served local governments and schools.
facts.system: National Data Transmission Backbone Infrastructure/e-Government Infrastructure Project Phase V

systems.system: National Data Transmission Backbone Infrastructure/e-Government Infrastructure Project (NBI/EGI), Phase V
systems.platform: optic fibre; supplier China International Telecommunication Construction Corporation
systems.tiers: About 50 per cent of the country after phases I to IV; Phase V to reach roughly 62 uncovered districts with last-mile connections; utilisation under 30 per cent of capacity

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and National Guidance; World Bank financed
systems.tiers: E-government services component and a digital-infrastructure component for refugee-hosting areas, with up to 200 masts; loan not yet disbursed at December 2023

note: The page is a summary of the Hansard, not the full text. No local government office is named as connected; the coverage figure is the minister's, of the country.
